scan.pinterest_status: Official Pinterest reporting and public Pinterest inspiration were checked on 9 October 2026. Pinterest's holiday optimization guidance supplied a materially useful creative-system signal: use at least three formats and five distinct creatives, with visible product, lifestyle context and an offer understood at a glance. The 6 October Beauty Trend Report and 2026 Palette remain active but are already represented. Public board pages were not directly accessible today; one was available only through its public search index.
scan.chatgpt_status: Production v2.19.0 with 715 commands was read before editing. v2.20.0 adds exactly one reusable command, /performance-creative-mix, while preserving all 715 prior commands, 40 executable bundles, settings, compatibility and Firefox updater controls. Repository bytes are verified; the browser-installed version remains locally observable only after userscript reload.
trends: performance creative breadth: use at least three genuinely different ad formats within an ad group
creative learning density: use five or more distinct ads so the system receives enough varied signals
format roles should span product-first hero, lifestyle or use context, creator/UGC proof, feature detail and concise offer or CTA
hold product identity, brand, approved claims and offer stable while testing hooks, framing, pacing, story and context deliberately
every asset needs a clear product, readable first-frame message and an explicit test hypothesis rather than unstructured variation
Pinterest Beauty Trend Report specificity and Beauty Guides reference-decoding remain active signals already covered by /beauty-trend-system
Pinterest Palette color-forward creative remains covered by /emotional-palette and existing brand/palette controls
commands_added: /performance-creative-mix — multi-format, five-creative product-ad matrix with explicit hypotheses, funnel roles, placements and testing order
skipped: No holiday-specific alias because the durable value is the reusable performance creative-mix and test architecture, not seasonal styling
No additional Beauty Trend Report or Beauty Guides commands because /beauty-trend-system already covers specificity, reference decoding and cross-format adaptation
No new palette commands because /emotional-palette and the existing brand, color and layout controls already cover monochrome walls, color-forward styling and focal accents
No commands were derived from inaccessible public board pages; search-index snippets repeated layout and branding inspiration without enough new evidence
